Group send, member change, read cursor, source deletion and private-setting writes use group-row-first locks. Legacy sends now revalidate current epoch and membership inside the message transaction, not only in preflight service checks.

New PATCH settings route is explicitly pinned in ordered route golden and documented as authenticated/current-active-own-member scoped; settings update uses a compile-time constant SQL query with bound arguments, without scanner exceptions.
